text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has officially won the Senior
Spring
Triple Crown after dominating
the Osaka Hai,
spring Tenno Sho, and
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a side effect of her success, her
fanbase has
grown dramatically...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get tons more hits when I look her up
on social
media sites, and anything the
academy publishes
about her accrues
attention.
choice_data_list: シャカールの話題、常に盛り上がってるな
シャカールの話題、常に盛り上がってるね
choice_data_list_en: People always get so hyped whenever Shakur comes up, huh.
People always get so hyped whenever Shakur comes up, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How 'bout that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid? Don't ask questions you
already
know the answer to.
choice_data_list: この機会に交流とかしてみる？
choice_data_list_en: Why not take this chance to mingle a bit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur still wants nothing to do with
her fans.
But just then, I come across an
interesting post.

text_block_list.name: @Sha_sha_sha
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it true Shakur's a former noble? I
totally
could see it, y'know. She's always
had a regal air
about her.

text_block_list.name: @MeatEnthusiast
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's actually a secret agent from
another
country. She keeps this country
safe from crisis
night after night—when
she isn't racing, of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A lot of false information about her has
been
floating around the net. When I
tell her this, Air
Shakur dismisses it
almost immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That kinda stuff doesn't last. Give it a
day and
they'll move on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just sit back and enjoy all the fabricated
drama.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's disdain for interviews has
resulted in
the public knowing almost
nothing about her.
Letting this sit will
probably just make the
speculation
worse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In reality, it becomes a problem far
sooner than
expected.
choice_data_list: （大きな騒ぎにならないといいけど）
choice_data_list_en: (I hope it doesn't cause a huge scene.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not like her to message me, but it is very like her to only send me a set of coordinates and the word "hurry."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, over here!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Keep your voice down, dummy!
choice_data_list: シャカール！何かあったのか？
シャカール！何かあったの？

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear someone call out
"Shakur" over there?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But she's supposed to be in front of the
station! Let's go
check if she's really
there!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This is gettin' old.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm gettin' played for a fool by a bunch
of even
bigger idiots, that's what! My
location's bein'
publicized live for the
world to see!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Someone snuck a photo of me while I
was
shoppin' and posted it online...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And now there's this dumb rumor that
catchin' me
in public'll help you level up
or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What am I, some kinda mythical
creature?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things are bad enough with the rumors
circling
around, but having her location
leaked online live
has created a perfect
storm.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch! I'm so damn pissed right now. How
dare they
treat me like some kinda toy!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I should hack all their phones and give
'em a taste
of their own medicine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is well within her rights to be
angry
over this, but from the posts I've
seen, some of
the fans just want the
opportunity to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we can use this situation to our
advantage, it
could be a good
opportunity for Air Shakur to
connect
with her fanbase. Hacking people's

phones is out of the question, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Go on!
choice_data_list: 情報操作するのはアリかも
choice_data_list_en: Spinning the narrative might actually work.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Shakur's at the park now?!"
"But I
just saw her eating at the shopping
district."
"Does she have a secret twin?
Or maybe she's a
ninja..."
choice_data_list: 複数アカウントってすぐに作れる？
choice_data_list_en: Can you set up multiple accounts quickly?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah. The seeds of chaos are startin'
to take
root.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's right, you clowns! How's it
feel to be
the ones getting played?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur uses her multiple new
accounts to
spread false sightings of
herself. The fallout is
intense, and it
becomes increasingly difficult to

pinpoint her location.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I threw my real location into the mix for
the hell
of it, but I already saw people
sayin' they're givin'
up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Things should simmer down soon
enough. No one
could possibly check
through this many places.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess I'd chat with them for a bit
as a
reward for their persistence.
choice_data_list: それでも探しにきた人がいたらどうする？
choice_data_list_en: Even so, what if someone comes looking for it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I doubt anyone's actually that dogged,
though.
Everyone's just been given the
runabout by the
people who started this
mess, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list_en: I'm not so sure about that.
I'm not so sure about that.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're really here!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Uh, um! I, um... I'm such a big fan of
yours!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
When I saw people posting locations
where we
might be able to meet you, I
rushed out and
began checking all the
spots people mentioned!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What? Did you seriously check every
single one?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! No one else I know is a fan, so I
didn't
have anyone to cross-check
information with...
But I couldn't pass up
this opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Wheeze, wheeze... I-I've finally found you... My light... My being...

text_block_list.name: Fan E
text_block_list.text:
No way! She's really here! Thank
goodness I didn't
wreck my bike for
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her fans cheered her on even when no
one else
would give her the time of day.
I knew there was
no way they'd be any
less determined than her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Damn you. I played right into your
hand.
choice_data_list: 探しに来た人がいたら……なんだっけ？
choice_data_list_en: If someone comes looking... what was it again?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You! The one who arrived first. C'mere.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cut straight to the chase. I don't wanna
hear any
sappy talk. You have two
minutes.
